input.quote: 10.3 Assignment. This Agreement shall be binding upon, and shall inure to the benefit of and be enforceable by, the parties hereto and their respective legal representatives, successors and assigns, but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 10.3 is a successors-and-assigns binding clause only: it neither grants us an express right to assign to an affiliate or transaction successor nor gates HDI's assignment. There is no notice requirement, no consent standard and no reasonableness qualifier, so the clause fails every fallback element on its material terms, and it leaves HDI free to assign the hosting arrangement (and our \"Deerskin\" brand engagement) to a competitor. No change-of-control termination or re-pricing right exists anywhere in the Agreement (Section 4.1 termination is mutual non-renewal on 90 days' notice), but nothing states this, so we captured it in the inserted language. We therefore added a short preferred-level assignment provision after Section 10.3 rather than rewriting the existing sentence.

proposal.summary: Add assignment rights and restrictions to Section 10.3: Company free assignment to affiliates/successors, consent gate on HDI assignment with no competitor assignment, and no HDI termination right on Company change of control.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3 only makes the Agreement binding on successors and assigns; it gives us no assignment rights and leaves HDI free to assign, including to a competitor. We added our standard position: we may assign to an affiliate or transaction successor without consent, HDI may assign only with our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to our competitor, and our change of control gives HDI no termination right.

ops.text: The Company may assign this Agreement without consent to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, and a change of control of the Company shall give HDI no right to terminate this Agreement. HDI may not assign this Agreement without the Company's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, and may in no event assign this Agreement to a competitor of the Company.

mappings.element: Customer may assign to an affiliate without consent.
Customer may assign to a successor in a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets without consent.
Vendor may not assign without Customer's consent.
Customer's consent to Vendor assignment is not to be unreasonably withheld.
Vendor may never assign to a Customer competitor.
Customer's change of control gives Vendor no termination right.
